title: hamelia glabra
intro: Hamelia glabra, commonly known as Indian tobacco, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hamelia glabra include its ability to reduce inflammation, combat infections, and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
